description:
Our flagship model in the popular Title Series, the Title Team complete race bike offers top-of-the-line BMX performance straight out-of-the-box. Designed for intermediate to advanced riders, the Title Team features Tectonic T1 biaxial hydroformed and butted aluminum frame, BOX One X5 pro carbon fork, 2-piece 24mm hollow spindle alloy cranks, and 24" x 1.75" Arisun XLR8 race tires on Xposure XR double walled, disc-specific rims with female axle sealed race hubs and rear mechanical disc brake. Race to the podium on the Mongoose Title Team.
Designed for the intermediate to advanced BMX racer who wants a lightweight, durable berm burner that has great spec and won’t break the bank. Suggested rider height is 5'7" and taller.
Full Tectonic T1 biaxial hydroformed and butted aluminum frame with 86 mm BB shell and tapered headtube delivers a lightweight ride with great control. 21.75" top tube length and frame weight of 4.0 lbs.
BOX One X5 pro carbon fork is lighter, stiffer, and features oversized technology for superior responsiveness and steering. 2-piece aluminum cranks offer high performance and low maintenance.
24" x 1.75" Arisun XLR8 race tires and Xposure XR double walled, disc-specific rims with female axle sealed race hubs – perfect for getting you out in front of the pack. Mechanical disc brake delivers superior stopping power at high speeds.
